VBO:0200795.summary: Lively, affectionate and responsive, the Kyi-Leo is described as a trusting, loyal companion. Its breed standard also emphasizes a calm, gentle manner. The breed developed from Lhasa Apso–Maltese stock, with Harriet Linn organizing its development from 1965 and working with other kennels before formalization in the 1970s.
VBO:0200795.shortDescription: A lively, loyal companion from Lhasa Apso–Maltese stock, with a breed standard that prizes responsiveness and a gentle manner.

sources.title: Continental Kennel Club — Kyi Leo standard and development history
sources.evidence: Actual entire CKC body personally read. Lively, affectionate, trusting, loyal and responsive companion plus calm/gentle standard ideal; public description calibrated, no small-animal/child safety guarantee or comparative superiority. Lhasa Apso–Maltese stock, Harriet Linn1965 organized development with other kennels and1970s formalization stated. Coherent literal anatomy: sturdy slightly rectangular medium-boned small body, moderate broad clean head with definite stop and moderate full broad muzzle, dark nose/eyes, high-set V drop/button ears, elbow-deep chest/level back, strong parallel limbs/compact paws, full high-inserted tail gracefully in one large curve above back. Long straight/slightly wavy shaggy soft silky single coat. Exact CKC color paragraph says pale ivory to pure white but own example photograph is black-white; contradictory numeric3:2 muzzle ratio plus prose topskull longer is excluded. Prompt uses observed black-white and only coherent qualitative muzzle anatomy.
